Commentary.Commentary: Whoa! Just 19.5 overs this morning and Australia have been bowled out. Yes, you read it right! The number one ranked Test team were ambushed by their eternal weakness - spin as Herath and Perera took 4 wickets apiece between them. The veteran left armer even took a hat-trick thereby being the second Sri Lankan ever to achieve the feat. Only Marsh today and Warner yesterday showed some fight for the Australians. This is Australia's lowest ever Test score in Sri Lanka. A mammoth 175-run lead for the hosts and the writing is on the wall for the tourists. The SL innings isn't far away, so don't go anywhere folks!

OUT! That's a brilliant catch by Karunaratne! Marsh swings accross the line but gets it off the toe end of the bat. Karunaratne who is stationed at straightish long off,  moves back, judges it perfectly and dives to his right and grabs a great catch! The Aussies are bundled out for a paltry score of 106 runs. Sri Lanka lead by 175 runs!

SIX! BOOM! Big hit! Floats it up on off, Marsh steps out to that one and carts it over long on for a biggie. Muscular stroke and nimble footwork from the all-rounder.
Four byes! Floats it up outside off, the slider bounces extra as Marsh is beaten on the push. It goes past Chandimal too as the ball races to the ropes. Byes signaled.

OUT! YES HE DOES! What a review in hindsight! Floats it up outside off, turns in sharply as Starc is rapped on the pads as he misses the line. Big appeal for lbw from the Sri Lankans but the umpire doesn't feel so. Mathews after a chat with Herath opts for the review. Impact is in line and guess what? It's just hitting the top of the stumps! A hat-trick it is for the old war horse Herath and all the Lankans are mobbing him in delight. Australia are down for the count at the moment.
SL have taken a review for lbw against Starc. Will Herath get his hat-trick?
MITCHELL STARC is the new man in. He'll face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! GONE FIRST BALL! Herath is all over the Aussies as the moment! Darted in on middle and leg, Nevill is late to get his bat down on the block as the ball thuds into the pads. Looked dead plumb to the naked eye and the umpire's finger goes up immediately. Nevill does think about the review but then decides against it after a chat with Marsh. Herath on a hat-trick now.
PETER NEVILL is the new man in.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says that the track looks flat and dry at the moment but there are quite a lot of patches developing in line with the stumps. The spinners' domination will increase as the match progresses. However, batsmen if they apply themselves can still score runs especially with the racy outfield.

A warm welcome to everyone! We saw an intriguing contest between bat and ball in Day 1. Mitchell Starc's 5-fer took Australia on the front foot. Kusal Mendis again came up with superb batting performance well supported by Kusal Perera and Angelo Mathews. But the loss of David Warner on the stroke of the day has slightly put the match on level terms as he was playing really well. Let's hope Day 2 also gives us another entertaining day of cricket. Stay tuned as we come up with live action in a while.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 1.....

Australia had 14 overs to negotiate before stumps and they nearly did it by losing only one wicket. But David Warner, who was looking in fine touch, fell in the last over of the day's play, leaving the match hanging in balance. The Aussies trail by 227 runs at the moment and will have to bat really well on this turner. We are expecting another exciting day tomorrow. Do join us at 1000 IST to catch all the action. Cheers!!!

What a day of Test cricket! 12 wickets fell and 335 runs scored. Sri Lanka opted to bat but will be disappointed with the fact that they managed only 281 runs in their first innings. Mitchell Starc was the chief destroyer, who claimed a 5-wicket haul. Kusal Mendis once again top scored for the hosts and missed out on a well deserved century by just 14 runs.

It goes to first slip where an ever alert Sri Lankan skipper snaps the catch inches above the surface. Warner is disappointed as he walks back. That also will be STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Well bowled! Beautiful flight from Perera, it drifts in and spins away, Warner stretches forward to defend but misses. Chandimal fails to grab it and Warner gets back in safely.

OUT! Early breakthrough for Sri Lanka and the debutant is off the mark in Test cricket! Short delivery on middle and leg, Burns rocks back and mishits his pull shot straight to Perera at mid-wicket. That was a nothing shot considering that he wasn't set at all and it was only the second ball that he had faced. He would be kicking himself! Fernando is delighted.
